# memtwig

> Git-native, multi-org Markdown memory layer for AI agents. Single static Go binary (CGO_ENABLED=0, ~12 MB) with SQLite FTS5 + optional vector RRF retrieval, deterministic proposal governance, MCP (stdio and Streamable HTTP with RBAC + audit log), and per-turn hooks for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity.

## Key Facts
- Website: https://memtwig.com
- Repository: https://github.com/vittoriocompagno/memtwig
- Latest Release: v1.0.0 (Apache 2.0) — https://github.com/vittoriocompagno/memtwig/releases/tag/v1.0.0
- Author: Vittorio Compagno (https://vittoriocompagno.com, https://github.com/vittoriocompagno)
- Language / Distribution: Pure Go static binary (Linux, macOS, Windows), zero CGO, zero external vector DB.
- Performance: 109 Markdown notes / 1,078 chunks indexed in ~105 ms.

## Documentation
- [Full Reference (Markdown)](https://memtwig.com/llms-full.txt): Consolidated single-file technical reference for LLMs.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/vittoriocompagno/memtwig/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Storage, scope routing, SQLite FTS5 + RRF engine, hook gating, MCP stdio/HTTP, RBAC, audit.
- [Multi-Org & Freelance Setup](https://github.com/vittoriocompagno/memtwig/blob/main/docs/multi-org.md): Strict isolation across personal and client vaults via `cwd` and `git remote`.
- [Harness Integration](https://github.com/vittoriocompagno/memtwig/blob/main/docs/harnesses.md): Setup for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity, and Hermes.
- [Governance & Curation](https://github.com/vittoriocompagno/memtwig/blob/main/docs/governance.md): Owner-locked notes, deterministic proposal IDs, secret scanning, `decide`, `invalidate`, `curate --llm`.
- [Example Config](https://github.com/vittoriocompagno/memtwig/blob/main/examples/config.toml): Ready-to-use `config.toml` with multi-org rules, embeddings, LLM curator, and RBAC tokens.
